title: [2.8.2.2 - dev] ISF lower than 2 mmol/l results in invalid profile
symptom: When setting the ISF lower than 2 mmol/l, the profile cannot be validated or saved. It was working correctly in 2.8.2 main.
cause: The hard limit for ISF is defined in mg/dl (MIN_ISF = 2.0) and is never translated to mmol/l, causing the validation to fail for mmol/l users.
fix: A fix was implemented by adding a check for units (mgdl vs mmol) in the isValidEditState function, converting the hard limits appropriately for mmol/l.
evidence_quote: part of the bug is in this place: app/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/utils/HardLimits.kt const val MIN_ISF = 2.0 // mgdl const val MAX_ISF = 720.0 // mgdl Apperently it is never translated to mmol/l.
